text: Fifty-six hours into the flight, Mission Control asked for a routine stir of the oxygen tanks, switching on small fans inside. The damaged wires sparked, and the insulation caught fire, inside a tank full of pure oxygen. The pressure soared, the tank failed, and the blast blew a whole panel off the side of the service module. Both tanks lost their oxygen. The fuel cells died, one by one. Odyssey was running out of power. The Moon landing was off. Now the only goal was getting home alive.
